Mara Hart

Walking, photographs and things I fix myself

Notes on long exposure at dusk
Nov 6, 2026 · 8 min read

I spent most evenings last month on the same stretch of shore with a tripod and a cheap ND filter, trying to get the water to go flat and silky.

A week of cycling the coast
Oct 16, 2026 · 8 min read

Seven days, a bit over five hundred kilometres, and more headwind than I would like to admit.

Rebuilding my home server
Oct 4, 2026 · 8 min read

The old box finally gave up after six years, so I used the excuse to start again from scratch and keep things simpler this time.

What I learned from a hundred rolls of film
Sep 7, 2026 · 4 min read

A hundred rolls sounds like a lot, but spread over three years it was really just one roll every week or so.

Small tools I use every day
Aug 2, 2026 · 6 min read

These are the few things that live on my desk and in my bag, and that I would buy again without thinking.

Walking the old railway line
Jul 18, 2026 · 4 min read

The line closed decades ago, but most of the route is still there if you know where to look.

Learning to repair my own bike
Jun 7, 2026 · 5 min read

The first repair took me a whole Saturday; the tenth took about twenty minutes.

A quiet weekend in the mountains
May 1, 2026 · 5 min read

We left on Friday evening with no real plan beyond a map, two days of food and a rough idea of the trail.
